name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Scroll Area. The scrollbar thumb is a flat of ink inset in a fine ink track (a 1px line on the start edge). No rounded pill, no opacity fade, a square corner. The viewport focus ring is an ink line inside the area. Keyboard and wheel behaviour are stock. Add a horizontal bar with ScrollBar orientation="horizontal". Works with Radix and Base UI.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/scroll-area". It wraps your own components/ui/scroll-area, so Radix and Base UI both work. The stock corner is left as the library draws it.

meta.tagline: Ink thumb in a fine track, square corners, no fade.
meta.usage:
import { ScrollArea, ScrollBar } from "@/components/ui/manga/scroll-area"
